# Studio Gallery: review guide

Status: draft for review; not an installed skill.

## Outcome

A searchable Studio gallery with main Draws, scope, and delivery links.

Reader: People and agents starting a similar design

## Procedure

### 1. Choose a goal

Browse Skill and Page design examples.

### 2. See why it exists

Read the purpose and delivery contract.

### 3. Explore the design

Open its main Draw and unresolved choice.

### 4. Follow the delivery

Open the associated product and reusable configuration.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Every example names a real source Studio.
- [ ] Draw and delivery links resolve.
- [ ] The purpose and intended reader are visible.
- [ ] The gallery does not use itself as an example.

## Open design choice

Should discovery start with a delivery type or a work scenario?
